description: beads-sigma-5d9k — ThoughtSpot window functions (cumulative_sum, moving_average, rank_desc, lag) must NOT land as DM calc cols/metrics (silent error type). Each becomes a flagged Null placeholder on the host + an auto-built grouped child element carrying the Sigma window calc (CumulativeSum/MovingAvg/Rank/Lag). Cross-element dim (rank by CUSTOMER_DIM.REGION) groups on the derived join view. Embedded usage (cumulative_sum(...)/100) degrades flag-only. `unique count` maps to CountDistinct.
